english.note: Use this when something moves a person deeply or stirs strong emotion, rather than physically carrying them.
Use this when a person is emotionally touched or moved by something.
Use this when touch means moving someone emotionally rather than making physical contact.
Use 感動 when something arouses tenderness, compassion, or another strong feeling in someone.

examples.english: This film really did transport me emotionally—I cried.
examples.traditional: 呢套戲真係感動到我喊。
examples.jyutping: ni1 tou3 hei3 zan1 hai6 gam2 dung6 dou3 ngo5 haam3
